text:
sara: Quick check-in  we need a final MVP cutlist before the weekly exec update. Options: tenant SSO, embeddings cache, model-pinning UI, in-console evals, and autoscale burst. Goal = ship a demoable surface and keep latency/cost targets.

alex: My vote: ship model-pinning + embeddings cache. Autoscale burst is ops config but needs runbook. Cut tenant SSO and in-console evals to v1.

ravi: embeddings cache is the cheapest cost win (est 15-25% token reduction on search). I can do a basic LRU prefix cache behind a flag in ~4 dev days.

maggie: Sales feedback: in-console evals are persuasive. If we cut them, add a clear "coming in v1" note and a pilot signup form.

ben: Risk lens: prefer low-risk, measurable wins. Cache + pinning moves the needle on unit economics and rollouts. Agree to defer SSO.

kyle: Ops note: autoscale burst config must have a safety cap and an auto-fallback if latency spikes. ETA for runbook + automation ~5 business days.

sara: Proposed cutlist for MVP: include embeddings cache (10% canary) and model-pinning UI, include autoscale config as limited scope, defer tenant SSO and in-console evals to v1/pilot.

alex: Canaries: start at 5% traffic, evaluate 24h. Graduation criteria: token delta <= -10%, p95 latency <= baseline * 1.2, error-rate < 0.5%. Auto-disable if criteria breached.

ravi: I'll add metric hooks: tokens_saved, cache_hit_rate, latency_p95, error_rate. Dashboard + alert for auto-disable.

maggie: I'll update the deck and add a slide: "Planned v1: in-console evals & tenant SSO (pilot)". Sales will use pilot language.

ben: PM asks: can we get engineering signoff in 48 hours? We need that to lock release notes and the milestone freeze.

alex: We'll aim for signoff. I'll add the canary steps into the PR template and include rollback commands.

kyle: Ops will deliver an auto-disable playbook and a small Lambda for the toggle action.

sara: Action items: (1) ravi + alex: PRs + canary dashboard (48h), (2) kyle: auto-disable runbook + toggle automation (3d), (3) maggie: sales + docs update (24h), (4) ben: finalize launch criteria and update release checklist.

deploy-bot: Milestone freeze scheduled in 5 days. See https://redwood-internal/boards/launch-1819999999. Automated reminders will post 48h before freeze.

sara: thanks all  please ack when you have assigned tasks. We'll freeze once signoffs are in. :rocket:
